QUOTE: When `hasSearch` is true, it renders `<NavigationSearch ... ref={ref} />` (line 134).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says NavigationHeader forwards its ref to NavigationSearch, rendered only when `hasSearch` is true. It does not say the ref attaches to nothing otherwise. It does say the header "doesn't use the ref itself", so the conditional-forwarding mechanism is stated.
